A bounce back to the $640k all-time high (about 2.2x from here) within 6 hours is quite plausible.

structured_output.thesis: A secondary SpaceX copycat, 21 minutes old. It pumped about 5x to an all-time high of about $640k and is now retracing hard at about $290k, while a larger SpaceX sibling dominates this ticker wave. Breadth is real (2k+ unique buyers, low concentration, burned LP), so it probably won't rug quickly. But entry comes mid-dump, a likely dev/team wallet holds 7.5%, and there are 52 bundlers. A 2x needs a full reclaim of the all-time high against a competing coin. That is below average for a runner, but not negligible given the strength of the name.
